svg.title: Fixed guard isolation and sparse Boolean prefix coverage
svg.desc: All six independent software joints hold. A false nonsquare certificate with empty output is rejected by the original checker and accepted only by a deliberately weakened mutant. A 256-bit cube is covered by two one-bit prefixes using three trie nodes; retaining only the zero prefix leaves gap one. These tests validate no arithmetic clause or solver speedup.

g.text: Six fixed software joints hold; arithmetic scope stays separate
7 independent families · 250 named assertions · original 18 regressions · zero solver runs
A guard isolated from model-set equality
False nonsquare row; D2 empty; digest correct
Same bad artifact; original source unchanged.
Both: covered, 3 nodes. Zero only: gap 1, 2 nodes.
No cube enumeration in these fixed fixtures.
No clause proof, transcript adapter, timing or ECDLP claim.
